player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ JoJoJoin, wɔ borɔd a ɛwɔ 5x5 a ɛwɔ cells a wɔahyehyɛ no 0-24.
Wɔ wo berɛ mu, fa wo mark si cell biara a ɛwɔ hɔ, e.g. '[12]'.
WOA DI NKUNIM wɔ bere a wo bɛnya FOUR wo marks wɔ pɛ mu — anan cells a ɛtoatoa wɔ mu horizontal, vertical, anaa diagonal.
Sɛ Player {player_id} wo ne '{symbol}'; wo opponent ne '{opponent_symbol}'.
